cells.quote: my younger brother came back from his masters. He was the one who said we cannot run the shop floor from one register anymore. He pushed for a production dashboard
A robot loader costs what I pay six operators for many years. Labour here is still cheap, so automation does not pay back unless the customer forces it.
automation does not pay back unless the customer forces it
We hired a young fellow from a polytechnic as an IT coordinator, and he is the one who actually set it up and trains the supervisors.
Their package was made for a plant that makes the same part all day. We are a job shop, every order has a different routing.
My brother uses ChatGPT to write quotation emails sometimes.
My father did not see the point, he walks the floor every morning and he knows which machine is down.
For anything above a few lakhs my father has the final word, and he will ask three people before he says yes.
